# QR Code generator library

Project Nayuki's C library: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
(https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library).

MIT licence, preserved in LICENSE and the source headers. The files are an
unchanged snapshot imported from SlipstreamCE commit
98f8b3cb28486db2c401c0898fcc58d1d4f1dd09. That snapshot did not record a Nayuki
release number; this commit and the checksums below identify the vendored version.

Used by the native link-account UI to draw QR codes.
